**Indikator 4a** tracks the proportion of patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation who are receiving anticoagulation treatment at one, two, and five years post-diagnosis. The national quality standard requires a treatment coverage of at least 90% across all time horizons [^src1]. Despite the critical importance of stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation, national performance consistently falls short of this benchmark. At the one-year mark, the national average was 88.2% in 2022/23 [^src6]; at two years, it was 89.6% [^src3]; and at five years, it dropped to 87.7% [^src4].

**Targets Met and Missed**
At the regional level, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] stands out as the only region that consistently meets or exceeds the 90% target across all evaluated timeframes, achieving 92.7% at two years [^src3] and 92.4% at five years [^src4]. In contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] persistently misses the target, recording 88.8% at two years [^src3] and 85.2% at five years [^src4]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] showed temporary improvement, reaching 90.3% at the one-year mark in 2021/22 [^src1], but regressed to 87.8% by 2022/23 [^src6].

**Leaders and Trailers**
Among specific hospital units, [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] and [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] are the top performers. Friklinikken achieved exceptional results, including 98.0% at two years [^src3] and a perfect 100.0% at five years [^src4], though these figures are based on small patient denominators. [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] also emerged as a leader in cluster-level comparisons, reaching 91.9% for two-year coverage, up from 88.1% in 2019/20 [^src5].

Conversely, several major hospitals act as consistent trailers. [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] struggles across all intervals, scoring 83.0% at one year [^src1] and dropping to 79.7% at five years [^src4]. [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved Sygehus]] also posts low figures, with 72.7% at one year [^src1] and 75.0% at two years [^src3]. [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] is a notable outlier at the five-year mark, falling to 71.1% [^src4]. The most severe outlier is [[garantiklinikken|Garantiklinikken]], which recorded just 53.8% treatment coverage at the two-year mark [^src3].

**Trends and Outliers**
Longitudinal data shows that national one-year treatment coverage has remained stubbornly flat, hovering around 88-89% over multiple reporting periods [^src1] [^src6]. While some specialized clinics like [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] demonstrate near-perfect adherence, their small denominators (e.g., 26 patients at five years [^src4]) limit their impact on the national average. Meanwhile, larger institutions like [[danmark|Danmark]]'s university hospitals continue to drag the national average below the 90% threshold, highlighting a systemic challenge in maintaining long-term anticoagulation therapy for atrial fibrillation patients.
